limitations: A consumer pass requires an actual official sing-box service; all DNS servers, outbounds, and HTTP fixtures are loopback observers.
The proxy/direct/bridge labels identify selected policy only, not real direct/proxy connectivity.
TLS tests send an actual ClientHello for sniffing, then receive a fixture marker; no TLS handshake or Claude session is completed.
IPv6 tests use ::1 ingress and controlled IPv6 destination metadata, not public IPv6 connectivity.
Policy reproduced from pinned tests/consumer_durability.py: global HTTPS suppression, product AAAA suppression, product IPv6 rejection, matched product proxy selection.
This is an isolated reference consumer, not the user production configuration or complete original rule ordering.
Positive Anthropic source-CIDR service ingress cannot be generated from loopback-only sockets without changing addressing or injecting metadata; it remains a matcher-only result from the prior suite.
No public URL availability, account operation, proxy exit, system DNS, TUN, firewall, route, production configuration, deployment, or publication was tested or changed.
